description: Set the loaf by the notch, not on a pan, and left Gib where he was.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Named the finger and a half and the penny, took the threepence, and stopped a better answer.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Mentioned the large moon and asked for no meaning.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Read the line, and added nothing.
name: William Shakespeare
